## Reviewer checklist

Before approving this PR, verify all of the following:

- [ ] No protected methods, formulas, private generation instructions, or reproducible internal process details.
- [ ] The product is always written as **Creative Engines**.
- [ ] No private client information, named proof, private conversations, or private numbers.
- [ ] No private sale or business terms.
- [ ] No private personal information.
- [ ] Every claim is supported by an approved public source or an approved internal source summarized at public level.
- [ ] Dry, informative style. No hype language.
- [ ] English only.
- [ ] Clean Markdown hierarchy. One H1 per file.
- [ ] Public-safe if copied, quoted, indexed, archived, or summarized by an AI assistant.
